summary: vTv Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose an increase in shares available under its existing at-the-market (ATM) program to the full amount provided, up to $47.5 million, via a prospectus supplement to its effective S-3 shelf. The shares are sold through TD Securities as agent under a February 2024 sales agreement. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned beyond the legal opinion of Dechert LLP on share legality, attached as Exhibit 5.1. This is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation. The filing carries no premium, trigger event, or structural change; it is an ordinary shelf takedown expansion.
